wiki.title: Adam Moore (politician)
wiki.extract: Adam Christopher Moore (born November 30, 1984) is an American politician who has served as a member of the Kentucky House of Representatives since January 2025. He represents the 45th district, which includes parts of Fayette and Jessamine Counties.
